mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE code = #{code}

SELECT food_type AS "foodType", net_weight AS "netWeight", ingredients_text AS "ingredientsText", allergens AS "allergens", manufacture_report_no AS "manufactureReportNo", packaging_material AS "packagingMaterial", shelf_life_months AS "shelfLifeMonths", shelf_life_unit AS "shelfLifeUnit",
COALESCE((SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = storage LIMIT 1), storage) AS "storage", label_style AS "layoutJson", label_extra AS "extraJson" FROM products WHERE code = #{code}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_label_versions WHERE product_code = #{code}
SELECT id FROM product_label_versions WHERE product_code = #{code} AND is_current = 1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM product_label_versions WHERE product_code = #{code} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE product_label_versions SET is_current = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", version_label AS "versionLabel", note AS "note", is_current AS "isCurrent", created_at AS "createdAt", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = created_by LIMIT 1), created_by) AS "createdBy" FROM product_label_versions WHERE product_code = #{code} ORDER BY id

SELECT id AS "id", product_code AS "productCode", version_label AS "versionLabel", note AS "note", is_current AS "isCurrent", created_at AS "createdAt", COALESCE((SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = created_by LIMIT 1), created_by) AS "createdBy", updated_at AS "updatedAt", food_type AS "foodType", net_weight AS "netWeight", ingredients_text AS "ingredientsText", allergens AS "allergens", manufacture_report_no AS "manufactureReportNo", packaging_material AS "packagingMaterial", shelf_life_months AS "shelfLifeMonths", shelf_life_unit AS "shelfLifeUnit", storage AS "storage", layout AS "layoutJson", extra AS "extraJson" FROM product_label_versions WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", size AS "size", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM label_templates ORDER BY name, id
SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", data_url AS "dataUrl", width_mm AS "widthMm" FROM label_marks ORDER BY name

SELECT return_exchange_location AS "returnExchangeLocation", customer_service_phone AS "customerServicePhone", business_name AS "businessName", business_address AS "businessAddress", notice_text AS "noticeText" FROM label_company_info WHERE id = 1

SELECT b.material_code AS "materialCode", COALESCE(m.name, b.material_name) AS "materialName", b.ratio_percent AS "ratioPercent" FROM bom b LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.code = b.material_code WHERE b.product_code = #{code} ORDER BY b.rank_in_product

SELECT m.name AS "materialName", m.allergens AS "allergens" FROM bom b JOIN materials m ON m.code = b.material_code WHERE b.product_code = #{code} AND m.allergens IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.allergens) != '' GROUP BY m.name, m.allergens ORDER BY MAX(b.ratio_percent) DESC
